kicker.zh: MoonBit 后端全家桶 · 教程

lead.en: A greeting service, built one layer at a time. Every chapter adds a single capability and leaves behind a service you can run, curl and read.
lead.zh: 一个问候服务，一层一层搭起来。每章只加一件事，留下的服务都能跑、能 curl、能读。

text.en: `moon` 0.1.20261104 or newer, a clone of this repository, and one `moon update`.
text.zh: 需要 `moon` 0.1.20261104 或更新版本，克隆本仓库，再跑一次 `moon update`。

text.en: Run it, read the code behind the output, then change something yourself.
text.zh: 先跑起来，再读输出背后的代码，最后自己改一处。

text.en: Where a library offers more than one, the code block switches between writing it, letting your types carry it, and letting annotations generate the glue.
text.zh: 库有多种写法的地方，代码块可以在三者之间切换：自己写、交给类型、交给注解。

foot.en: every output on these pages is from a real run
foot.zh: 本站每个输出都来自真实运行
